instructions.name: accept
docs: Seller accepts the terms and posts the stake (Pact). Work starts only after this.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Buyer withdraws an offer the seller has not accepted. Full refund, budget credited back.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: challenge
docs: Buyer disputes the delivery inside the review window, posting a bond (Reckn / Recourse).
Only possible when the deal names a verifier, so a challenge can always be decided.

instructions.name: claim
docs: After the review window with no challenge, anyone may settle to the seller (buyer silence
= acceptance). Funds can only go to the deal's own seller and buyer token accounts.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: create_deal
docs: Buyer opens a deal and moves the order amount into the vault. Policy is checked first.

accounts.name: seller
docs: tokens into its own token account.

accounts.name: approver
docs: Required only when the amount is above the policy's approval threshold.

instructions.name: init_policy
docs: Buyer creates their spending policy. Deals can only be opened through a policy.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Deadline passed without delivery: anyone may refund. If the seller had accepted, the
stake is slashed to the buyer (Pact's late penalty; computed from chain time, not a flag).

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: release
docs: Buyer approves exactly the delivery it names (approval bound to the hash, AutoVoyage).

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: resolve
docs: The deal's verifier decides a challenge within the resolve window.
Pass: seller paid as on release, plus the buyer's bond. Fail: buyer gets everything back
and the seller's stake is slashed to the buyer.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: submit_delivery
docs: Seller records the delivery hash and invoices. The invoice must match the order amount
within the agreed tolerance (Procure's match, enforced on chain).

instructions.name: timeout_refund
docs: No verdict within the resolve window: anyone may refund the buyer (order + bond); the
seller gets the stake back, since the missing verdict is not the seller's fault. Its own
status (NoVerdict) keeps it distinguishable from a missed-deadline refund on chain.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Buyer changes their policy. Spent-in-period is kept, so a change can't reset the budget.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: DeadlineInPast
errors.msg: Deadline must be in the future

errors.name: BadReviewWindow
errors.msg: Review window must be between 0 and 30 days

errors.name: SelfDeal
errors.msg: Buyer and seller must differ

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: Deal is not in the right status for this action

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Delivery deadline has passed

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Deadline has not passed yet

errors.name: ReviewWindowOpen
errors.msg: Buyer review window is still open

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not a party to this deal

errors.name: DeadlineTooFar
errors.msg: Deadline is more than 30 days away

errors.name: BadTolerance
errors.msg: Invoice tolerance must be at most 20%

errors.name: BadBond
errors.msg: Challenge bond must be at most 50%

errors.name: BadResolveWindow
errors.msg: Resolve window must be between 60 seconds and 30 days

errors.name: VerifierNotIndependent
errors.msg: The verifier must be neither buyer nor seller

errors.name: PolicyMintMismatch
errors.msg: Policy is for a different token

errors.name: SellerNotAllowed
errors.msg: Seller is not on the buyer's allowlist

errors.name: OverMaxPrice
errors.msg: Amount is above the buyer's max price

errors.name: OverPeriodBudget
errors.msg: Amount would exceed the buyer's budget for this period

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.msg: Amount is above the approval threshold and the approver did not sign

errors.name: EmptyDelivery
errors.msg: Delivery hash must not be empty

errors.name: InvoiceMismatch
errors.msg: Invoice does not match the order amount within tolerance

errors.name: DeliveryMismatch
errors.msg: Release names a different delivery than the one submitted

errors.name: NoVerifier
errors.msg: This deal has no verifier, so it cannot be challenged

errors.name: ReviewWindowClosed
errors.msg: Review window has closed

errors.name: NotVerifier
errors.msg: Only the deal's verifier can resolve

errors.name: ResolveWindowClosed
errors.msg: Resolve window has closed

errors.name: ResolveWindowOpen
errors.msg: Resolve window is still open

errors.name: Conservation
errors.msg: Payout does not equal what the vault holds for this deal

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: BadPolicy
errors.msg: Invalid policy parameters

fields.name: approver
docs: Default pubkey = nobody may approve, so amounts above the threshold are refused.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Default pubkey = no verifier; challenges are then impossible.

fields.name: amount
docs: The order (PO) amount the buyer escrowed.

fields.name: terms_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical terms the buyer approved (core `termsHash`).

types.name: RepPair
docs: The history between one seller and one buyer.

types.name: SellerRep
docs: A seller's track record in one token, written only by `settle`.

fields.name: mint
docs: Amounts are only comparable within one mint; scoring reads the USDC record.

fields.name: volume
docs: Sum of amounts paid for completed work (min(invoice, order)), excluding stakes and bonds.

fields.name: distinct_buyers
docs: Buyers with at least one completed deal with this seller.

fields.name: max_pair_volume
docs: The largest completed volume with any single buyer (concentration check).
